item.title: England beat France to win wheelchair Rugby League World Cup
item.body: England became back-to-back world champions, and champions for the third time, after beating France 50-38 in the wheelchair Rugby League World Cup final in Australia.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏆 England beat France to win wheelchair Rugby League World Cup

England became back-to-back world champions, and champions for the third time, after beating France 50-38 in the wheelchair Rugby League World Cup final in Australia.

Source: BBC Sport | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 13 November, 11:50
